requirement: Embeddable voice widget keeps the mobile conversation visible and isolates inline sign-in credentials

oracle.invariant: Operator switch off and foreign-origin writes are refused. OTP is verified for the bound email, excluded from history, and choices are retained. Google requires a freshly attested OAuth callback and a single-use flow. Mobile transcript scrolling, catalogue browsing and viewport resize keep the orb/composer visible. Spoken email is read back before confirmation; OTP verifies on the same microphone and normal conversation resumes. The visitor cookie is host-only and partitioned; sign-out clears the same path and partition. The website widget is hidden by default until the operator enables its switch. Every registered widget route appears in the API reference, with no documented route missing from the app. A backend renewal of the internal guest session never sets that credential in the visitor browser.
